dependency_premises: The std helper bodies use the open CharExt::to_utf8 model and the recursive Seq<char>::to_bytes model; no UTF-8 boundary lemma is trusted.
The actual Seq<char>::to_bytes body has a separate one-VC std proof, recorded in the ByteStr evidence manifest.
Range<usize> str indexing and str::split_at are external std contracts. Their callers here prove the required byte-prefix boundary witnesses before invoking them.
The bundled Creusot char model constrains values to < 0x10FFFF, excluding valid U+10FFFF; claims inherit that model limitation.
limitations: The range-index contract applies only when both byte endpoints equal UTF-8 byte lengths of ordered character prefixes.
The ASCII delimiter helpers support arbitrary modeled Unicode around a selected ASCII byte; they do not assume all input characters are ASCII.
No core-library implementation is included or proved by this target.
